why: Published *.json under course/ and corpus/ that contracts/manifest.json deliberately does NOT catalogue as an entity, each with the reason it is not schema'd. validate_course_chain.py fails on any published JSON that is neither matched by an entity glob nor listed here, and an entry here that matches no file on disk is ALSO a failure — so this list cannot rot into a blanket amnesty. Paths are repo-relative, forward slashes, no globs. Adding a real learner-facing entity here instead of to contracts/manifest.json is the abuse this file is watched for: a derived projection, a review queue or a quarantine log qualifies; a registry does not.

files.reason: Redirect map {old grammar slug: survivor slug} written by export_corpus.py for the records that scripts/migrate_grammar_merge.py merged into another (owner decision A3). A tombstone index, not a record set: it publishes no content, only the address a retired identity now resolves to. It sits beside corpus/grammar/ rather than inside it because the grammar entity glob is corpus/grammar/*.json and check_catalogue refuses a non-list sidecar in a registry glob.

Flat derived projection of the whole course tree for navigation UI. Every field in it is recomputed from the lesson leaves and gated for exact equality by validate_course_chain.py itself, so a schema would restate a shape that is already pinned by derivation.
Exemption ledger read by validate_unlock_ledger.py — a validator input recording which taught-level records are knowingly untaught. Project bookkeeping, not corpus or courseware content.
Teacher review queue for the homograph placements the export could not decide. A work-item list that shrinks to nothing once the decisions are made; it addresses records but publishes none.
Exemption ledger read by validate_exercise_contracts.py — the lessons that teach items yet render no practice, held with a reason. Validator bookkeeping, not courseware.
Exemption ledger read by validate_lesson_gating.py — the item references a body renders before the course unlocks them, held with a reason. Validator bookkeeping, not courseware.

Exemption ledger read by validate_stroke_integrity.py — the kanji/kana whose stroke data is a known acquisition hole and the two records whose stroke counts legitimately disagree. Validator bookkeeping, not corpus content.
Exemption ledger read by validate_graph_edges.py — the lessons corpus/capabilities/lesson_map.json deliberately leaves unmapped, each with a written status. Validator bookkeeping, not corpus content.

Quarantine log of the 93 exam items withdrawn by scripts/contracts/migrate_exam_banks_p7.py, kept in full so nothing is silently lost. The exam_item glob (corpus/exam_banks/n[0-9]_*.json) excludes it on purpose: these items are NOT published to learners.
